items.title: 20+ Years Bridging Infrastructure & Applied AI
items.content: Bay Area Software Engineer and AI Systems Architect. After 17 years building large-scale hardware validation and telemetry pipelines at Intel and leading CI/CD automation at GlobalFoundries, I now focus on applied AI—designing multi-agent workflows, sub-100ms RAG retrieval, and security-first cloud architectures.

items.title: PivotBridge AI Career Platform
items.content: Founding Engineer & AI Architect. Built a full-stack career intelligence platform from the ground up featuring a 7-step assessment, personalized career roadmaps, and the Aurora AI chat agent. Powered by Python, React/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Milvus vector search, and multi-agent fallback routing on GCP.

items.content: Engineered a real-time Python inferencing engine combining YOLOv11 and RetinaFace for simultaneous bounding-box detection and facial localization at 30+ FPS, paired with a dynamic labeling and custom weight evaluation pipeline.

items.content: Took the core AI platform from concept to production MVP 30% ahead of schedule. Engineered defensive input-sanitization guardrails against prompt injection, reduced unstructured data anomalies by 38% via agentic split-logic routing, and scaled containerized microservices behind GCP Cloud Load Balancers.

items.content: Built fault-tolerant asynchronous Python pipelines integrating Zoom and Google Drive APIs to automate classroom media distribution (saving 15 hrs/week) and refactored GCP OAuth 2.0 pathways to cut login errors by 22%. Lead technical workshops mentoring graduate and MBA students on AI and cloud workflows.
